verdict.rationale: BILL markets 'AI-powered spend management' that automatically categorizes transactions and checks compliance, and it offers AI multi-line bill coding through the Invoice Coding Agent. These are AI-generated suggestions drawn from the user's own data inside the product. However, the evidence shows only automated categorization and coding, not insights, analytics or recommendations surfaced to the user, and every claim is marketing-level. Missing for 10: AI-generated insights or analytics on spend data, user-facing proactive suggestions or recommendations, in-depth documentation of how the AI features work, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
